statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Agent Cards MAY be digitally signed using JSON Web Signature (JWS) as defined in RFC 7515 to ensure authenticity and integrity.
actions: Digitally sign Agent Card using JSON Web Signature (JWS) as defined in RFC 7515

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Before signing, the Agent Card content MUST be canonicalized using the JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) as defined in RFC 8785.
actions: Canonicalize Agent Card content using JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) as defined in RFC 8785 before signing

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Before canonicalization, the JSON representation MUST respect Protocol Buffer field presence semantics as defined in Section 5.7.
actions: Apply Protocol Buffer field presence semantics to JSON representation before canonicalization

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields marked with the optional keyword that were not explicitly set MUST be omitted from the JSON object
actions: Omit optional fields that were not explicitly set from the JSON object

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields marked with optional that were explicitly set to a value (even if that value matches a default) MUST be included in the JSON object
actions: Include optional fields that were explicitly set in the JSON object even if the value matches a default

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields marked with REQUIRED MUST always be present, even if the field value matches the default.
actions: Include REQUIRED fields in the JSON object even if the field value matches the default

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Fields with default values MUST be omitted unless the field is marked as REQUIRED or has the optional keyword.
statements.pre_cond: agent_card.field.has_default_value = true & agent_card.field.marked_required = false & agent_card.field.marked_optional = false
actions: Omit fields with default values from the JSON object unless the field is marked as REQUIRED or has the optional keyword

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The Agent Card JSON MUST be canonicalized according to RFC 8785, which specifies:
actions: Apply predictable lexicographic ordering of object properties
Apply consistent representation of numbers, strings, and other primitive values
Remove insignificant whitespace

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: The signatures field itself MUST be excluded from the content being signed to avoid circular dependencies.
actions: Exclude the signatures field from the content being signed

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.post_cond: agent_card.signature.protected_header.alg != null & agent_card.signature.protected_header.typ != null & agent_card.signature.protected_header.kid != null
actions: Include alg parameter in JWS protected header
Include typ parameter in JWS protected header
Include kid parameter in JWS protected header

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: typ: SHOULD be set to "JOSE" for JWS
actions: Set typ parameter to 'JOSE' in JWS protected header

statements.subject: agent_card
actions: Optionally include jku (URL to JSON Web Key Set containing the public key) parameter in JWS protected header

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients verifying Agent Card signatures MUST:
actions: Extract the signature from the signatures array
Retrieve the public key using the kid and jku or from a trusted key store
Remove properties with default values from the received Agent Card
Exclude the signatures field
Canonicalize the resulting JSON using RFC 8785
Verify the signature against the canonicalized payload

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients SHOULD verify at least one signature before trusting an Agent Card
actions: Verify at least one signature in the Agent Card before trusting it

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Public keys SHOULD be retrieved over secure channels (HTTPS)
actions: Retrieve public keys over secure channels (HTTPS)

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Clients MAY maintain a trusted key store for known agent providers
actions: Maintain a trusted key store for known agent providers

statements.subject: client
statements.description: Expired or revoked keys MUST NOT be used for verification
actions: Reject use of expired or revoked keys for signature verification

statements.subject: agent_card
statements.description: Multiple signatures MAY be present to support key rotation
actions: Include multiple signatures in Agent Card to support key rotation
